model_annotation: The plot illustrates training loss versus iteration for multiple model variants, shown as overlaid line curves with semi-transparent shaded bands around each curve. The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 140,000 with regularly spaced tick labels at 20,000-iteration intervals. The y-axis is labeled “Loss,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 with tick labels spaced by 0.1. Six solid lines are shown with no point markers: the purple “Vanilla” curve starts near the top of the axis around 3.4 at iteration 0, drops steeply to roughly 2.65 by about 10,000 iterations, and then declines gradually to about 2.47 by 140,000; the light-blue “StrmLLM (n=64)” curve begins around 3.4, decreases rapidly to about 2.85 by ~10,000, then tapers downward to around 2.62 at 140,000; the orange curve (legend entry corresponding to “SepLLM (n=64)”) starts near 3.4, falls to roughly 2.70 by ~10,000, and then trends down to about 2.52 by 140,000; the green “SepLLM (n=64, H)” line similarly drops from about 3.4 to around 2.68 by ~10,000 and then gradually reaches about 2.51 at 140,000; the red “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” line follows the same overall shape, falling from about 3.4 to roughly 2.67 by ~10,000 and ending near 2.50 at 140,000; and the dark-blue “SepLLM (n=128)” curve starts near 3.4, descends to approximately 2.66 by ~10,000, and then slowly decreases to around 2.49 by 140,000.
